WITH ProjectRevenue AS (

    FROM
        analytics.invoices AS i
    JOIN
        analytics.invoice_lines AS il ON i.id = il.invoice_id
    GROUP BY
        i.project_id
),
ProjectCosts AS (
    SELECT
        pc.project_id,
        SUM(pc.amount) AS total_costs
    FROM
        analytics.project_costs AS pc
    GROUP BY
        pc.project_id
)
SELECT
    p.name AS project_name,
    COALESCE(pr.total_revenue, 0) AS invoiced_revenue,
    COALESCE(pc.total_costs, 0) AS project_costs,
    COALESCE(pr.total_revenue, 0) - COALESCE(pc.total_costs, 0) AS project_margin
FROM
    analytics.projects AS p
JOIN
    ProjectRevenue AS pr ON p.id = pr.project_id
LEFT JOIN
    ProjectCosts AS pc ON p.id = pc.project_id
ORDER BY
    p.name;

WITH project_total_costs AS (
  SELECT
    p.id AS project_id,
    p.project_code,
    p.name AS project_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(pc.amount), 0) AS total_cost
  FROM analytics.projects AS p
  LEFT JOIN analytics.project_costs AS pc
    ON p.id = pc.project_id
  GROUP BY
    p.id, p.project_code, p.name
),
overall_average_cost AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(total_cost) AS average_cost
  FROM project_total_costs
)
SELECT

  ptc.project_name
FROM project_total_costs AS ptc
CROSS JOIN overall_average_cost AS oac
WHERE
  ptc.total_cost > oac.average_cost;
